SECTIONS  snetwork SECTION [ITEM]
  interfaces [NAME]   every interface, the default route first
  subnets             networks you sit on, and those a VPN reaches; default routes
  devices [SUBNET]    devices in the ARP cache, per subnet you sit on
  dhcp [NAME]         lease, server, router and DNS, and time left
  dns                 resolvers in the order macOS asks them
  wifi                band, channel, width, signal, noise, rate
  vpn [PEER]          Tailscale peers and routes; other VPNs
  firewall            the macOS application firewall
  listening           TCP ports that accept connections from other machines
  all                 every section in full

NOTES
  devices   counts what this Mac has talked to lately. It is not a scan,
            and it cannot see subnets behind a VPN.
  wifi      macOS hides the network name unless your terminal has
            Location Services permission. Everything else shows without it.
  firewall  pf needs root, so snetwork does not read it.
